definitions.explanation: A gathering held after an event or project to look back on what happened, discuss what went wrong, and draw lessons for next time.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{後|あと}で{反省会|はんせいかい}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: We held a review meeting after the match.

examples.japanese: イベントの{反省会|はんせいかい}で{改善点|かいぜんてん}を{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: At the event debriefing, we discussed points to improve.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトが{終|お}わると、チームで{反省会|はんせいかい}を{開|ひら}いて{次|つぎ}に{生|い}かす{課題|かだい}を{整理|せいり}した。
examples.english: When the project ended, the team held a review meeting and organized the issues to apply next time.

notes:
Compound of {反省|はんせい} (reflection, self-examination) + {会|かい} (meeting). Despite the word's literal sense, a {反省会|はんせいかい} can be lighthearted — among friends it sometimes just means gathering for drinks to rehash an event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反省会|はんせいかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a review meeting
- {反省会|はんせいかい}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct a debriefing
- {一人|ひとり}{反省会|はんせいかい}: privately replaying one's own mistakes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {打|う}ち{上|あ}げ: celebration party (after an event) — festive, to mark completion rather than to reflect
- {会議|かいぎ}: meeting — the general word, with no reflective purpose implied
